title: Wildfire Preparedness
description: Follows the Ready, Set, Go! approach: defensible space and home hardening before fire season, leaving early, and what to do if trapped in a car, on foot, or at home. Covers smoke and the Air Quality Index, N95 respirators and clean rooms, and returning home safely.
shortDescription: Ready, Set, Go!, defensible space zones, leaving early, and wildfire smoke
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
